full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 2898, June 1, 2020>
(1) (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on March 1, 2021.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Scope of Adjudicative Affairs) Cases to be tried by the Ulsan Outlying Division of the Busan High Court under amended Article 2 for which an appeal or interlocutory appeal was filed before March 1, 2021 shall be tried by the Busan High Court.
